title: Mariner 9's "Inca City" ruins near the Martian south pole
place_text: Near the south pole of Mars

tellings.quote: pictures of what looked like ancient ruins these ancient ruins were even in formally dubbed by their team as the Incan City

plain: In 1972 the NASA probe Mariner 9 sent back photographs from near the south pole of Mars showing what looked like ancient ruins, which the mission team informally nicknamed the "Inca City". Jesse Michels tells this himself, pointing to the Mariner 9 photographs, as a possible sign that someone once built on Mars.
